mapper.select: SELECT T.T_CODE, T.T_IMG, T.T_NAME, T.T_STADIUM, T.T_VIC, T.T_DRAW, T.T_LOSE, T.T_INTRO FROM USER U, TEAM_MANAGEMENT TM, TEAM T WHERE U.U_CODE=TM.U_CODE and TM.T_CODE=T.T_CODE AND U.U_CODE = #{u_code};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEAM(T_IMG, T_NAME, T_STADIUM, T_VIC, T_DRAW, T_LOSE, T_INTRO) VALUES(#{t_img}, #{t_name}, #{t_stadium}, 0, 0, 0, #{t_intro});
